Hi Harry,

I came across Thomas Potter while researching UK fastener and fittings stockists — your deep holding of non-preferred items since 1923 really stands out.

I'm Leo from KaiLionCrafts, based in Yangjiang, China, the country's hardware and cutlery capital. We partner with four family-backed factories on OEM/ODM metal products, MOQ from 100 pcs, backed by SGS/LFGB/FDA standards. We also supply free product photos, videos and factory footage under your own brand, and factory-direct pricing typically runs about 20% below trading houses.

Would a short WhatsApp call or a quick catalog be useful if you are ever evaluating alternative metal-hardware sourcing?

Best,
Leo Li
KaiLionCrafts | WhatsApp: +86 131-3800-6564
kailioncrafts.com/oem-odm/
